summary: JSON output must be a valid empty document ([] for list commands, {} for digest's groups object — never null, nothing, or hint text) when results are empty; result slices that feed a JSON encoder are initialized with make(..., 0) instead of a nil var declaration.
reason: Five commands (articles, open-access, search, trends, reading-list ls) wrote a human-readable hint to stderr and returned nil with no stdout output when the local corpus was empty; this left stdout empty and caused json_fidelity dogfood tests to fail with 'invalid JSON'. Also added Example field to reading-list ls which was missing. Follow-up: reading-list ls, feedback recent, and doctor's cache report encoded a nil slice directly, emitting null instead of [] for empty lists. Second follow-up (Greptile P1s on PR #1328): since and digest had the same empty-stdout gap; since now emits [], digest emits {} to match its populated object shape. Third follow-up: the empty-JSON guard must be gated on flags.asJSON — trends emitted the literal [] to stdout in human terminal mode too, the inverse defect.
validated_outcome: Full live dogfood gate passes with 0 failures after this fix.
